The '''LW-1S''' was a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] model produced by [[Vectron]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Its engines extended outward from the pod at the pilot's command.

==Behind the scenes==
The Vectron LW-1S was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on [[October 20]], [[2015]] as one of the items in the Underworld Alliance Pack on the Cartel Market.
